title: Hanasato Minori — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few days before Minori's birthday
carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...! Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. I wasn't expecting so many people to come! What a surprise!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course we came. Who'd miss a good friend's birthday?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I actually asked Shii and her friends if they knew a good place to hold your party.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you did?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's a special day, after all. I thought it would make you happiest to celebrate with lots of people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And Saki was the one who suggested holding the party here at the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I see! So that's why the manager wished me a happy birthday too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. You seemed really happy about that, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I just really wasn't expecting the manager to do that for me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially as soon as I came into the cafe! I got totally blindsided!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe♪
Everyone was all sparkly smiley☆

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And, guess what! Ena got a perfect snapshot of your face at that very moment♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! When did you even?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. I saw my chance and took it.
I'll send this to you later, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe we should send it to An and Kohane too. They were really bummed they couldn't make it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah, but they said they'll definitely catch the stream!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! That's so nice of them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Speaking of which, are you all ready for the stream?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... Everything I was in charge of is ready!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In charge of?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't actually know what the plan is for today's stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We're preparing everything in secret.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's her birthday, after all, so we figured, why not make it a surprise?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I see. I feel like that would just make me nervous...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi and the others won't even give me hints about what they're planning, so I've just been wondering this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't worry, it'll be fun for you and for our fans, so just look forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wonder what it is. Ooh, what if they set off a big firework on stream?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I don't really see that happening...
But it sounds like it'll be a fun surprise, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait!
The cake is all ready!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hooray! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, I've really been looking forward to the specialty birthday cake! It has lots of yummy toppings and frosting and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! This is a little different from the cake I was expecting!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This drawing on the chocolate plaque... Is this me?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And there's a little me on top of the cake too! And a Haruka, and an Airi, and a Shizuku too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A+ reaction, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We got to thinking that it would be a shame to have them bring out exactly the cake you were expecting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So we thought, if we adjust the design a little bit, that might make for a really fun surprise.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ena was the one who did the drawing of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we made the little figures of us out of marzipan, with help from Emu and the others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We thought, since we're doing all this, why not make the whole cake MORE MORE JUMP! themed?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You mean, this is a special, one-of-a-kind MORE MORE JUMP! birthday cake?! That's... That's...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's so cute, I can't bring myself to eat it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, dear.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's a cake, it's meant to be eaten!
And we have a lot more party planned for afterward!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay... I'll do my best!
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So then, after we all had cake, we played board games together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wasn't doing very well, but everyone cheered me on together. And in the end, I turned it around! I was so happy...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. It sounds like it was a very fun party!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! So many people were there to celebrate with me. It really filled me with so much energy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And everyone said they'll be watching my birthday stream, too. I'll have to really make it a great one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right! I have to read those over before stream!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <“Those”?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, the fan letters I got! So many people sent me happy birthday wishes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It really makes me so happy to get so many messages from our fans...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Each message from a fan contains their heartfelt feelings, after all. Even more so when it's a birthday message.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. It sounds like you'll have a wonderful birthday, full of warm wishes.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it's not even my actual birthday yet. Is it really okay for me to get so many kind messages?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Don't worry! Have your fill and enjoy♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aw, thanks! But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It makes me so happy that everyone is thinking of me and wants to send me such kind words and wishes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just feel like I have to give back as much... No, I need to give back more and more gratitude to all of them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wonder if there's a way I can...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...! I know!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Landed on a good idea?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I sure did!
